verdict.rationale: The evidence points to the building blocks: multi-user workspaces (docs-4), dynamic model selection and model swapping (docs-15, docs-9), system prompt configuration (docs-21), custom agent workflows and Agent Flows (docs-9, docs-22), and embeddable chat widgets that could act as separate entry points (docs-19). None of it explicitly shows distinct agents, each with its own prompt, model and workspace, with conversations routed between them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-workspace or per-agent prompt and model configuration, any routing of conversations or channels to specific agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-agent setups.
